evidence.observation: Pressure 2.938 Torr at start of growth, in line with the ramp baseline of about 2.94 Torr.
Pressure has risen steadily to 3.208 Torr (+0.27 Torr in 720 s, about 18x the noise), and the rise is speeding up.
Ar flow steady at about 100 sccm, so the rise is not caused by extra gas input.
Temperature steady at 750 °C and heater power steady at about 45%, so thermal control looks normal.
No exhaust O2 sensor is installed, so air ingress (leak) can't be told apart from a blocked exhaust, and the growth atmosphere can't be verified.
